Screen snapshots enumerate windows once and derive keyboard visibility from the same observation.
Optional per-request profile records cache, windows, roots, children and local traversal/encoding timings; it reads no profiling clocks when disabled.
Agent and driver protocol versions advance together to replace older running agents. Explicit prefetchChildren:false supports controlled comparisons.

Motion/replay guards, flow assertions and timing budgets.

read_benchmark.method: Same final agent build, fixed app state per fixture, eight warmup reads, 15 repetitions of false/true/true/false, 30 fresh-cache reads per mode. Explicit profile:true. No concurrent build, unit test or other device benchmark during final measurements.

limitations: These are four fixed screens on one Android 16/API 36 emulator, not a universal latency guarantee. Each mode has 30 interleaved samples. Older Android behavior is gated but was not tested on an older device.
Snapshot equality checks cover the complete app windows. System/IME text can change independently; serialized node counts match across both modes. All measured reads explicitly clear node caches.
Per-phase medians are independent and need not add up to the median total. Local walkEncodeMs includes cached property access, traversal and JSON building, not only serialization.
Agent timers exclude final response string/UTF-8 conversion, socket transfer and host decoding; Python roundtrip timers include reply JSON parsing and diagnostic metadata.

Both A/B modes use the single-window fix, isolating the child-prefetch effect. The single full Everyday before/after pair compares the complete prior and final implementations and is only a diagnostic flow timing.

Exploratory fixture setup failures and the moving-logo fixture are retained under build/read-fetch-optimization; they are excluded from the final uncontended dataset. The static native Views scenario list replaced the moving fixture.

Ten native and three Flutter animation passes are a bounded reliability sample. No flow retries were used. No commit was created. The validated runner is installed in bin/tb; emulators remain running.
